effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and gets +2000 DP for every 4 cards in your opponent's hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an effect adds cards to your opponent's hand, unsuspend this Digimon.
